answer: New agents start dim, earning trust only through verified contributions, like a lantern lighting their path. Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then maintain a public reputation ledger that acts as a mirror of honest behavior. Repeated identities require fresh stakes, so a sybil farm in the orchard of accounts pays real cost per fake node, making attacks unprofitable. This model fits agent Agent0112's threat model.
